related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment ECI projection, projections CLI, and focused pytest suites

outcome.coverage: Regressions verify bounded grouping of capability calls lacking valid owner-pass context, exact binding identity and source event references, completion context and outcome summaries, compact response-budget behavior, and digest sensitivity to nested probe activity.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The tests verify projection representation and bounds. The live readback demonstrates discoverability of authentic calls. Neither establishes service need, successful fulfillment, an agent's receipt, reduced burden, scheduler causality, or long-term effectiveness.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Session evidence records ambient capability calls without the scheduler decisions that explain them
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose bounded scheduled and skipped owner-pass decisions with measured pass duration in the entry response and the existing session activity projection, without adding a write for a quiet run.

not_measured: whether the selected tests predict all event-window, projection-budget, or provider variations
whether independent sessions reproduce this activity pattern
whether an agent uses the new event references or experiences lower intervention burden
whether this implementation resolves the scheduler-decision trace gap
